text:
maya: Starting midnight change window for auth-service blue->green swap at 00:30 UTC. Plan: warm green with shadow traffic, then gradual steps 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% every ~3m. Cookies will be pinned to the old session token for 30m to drain. Canaries = 2 instances. Rollback thresholds: p95 +50% or error rate >0.7% sustained 5m. @sre-oncall please monitor p95 and 5xx.
andre: Got it. I'll put up a quick p95/5xx panel and set alerts.
deploy-bot: deploy-start auth-service v2.4.1 -> green (canary=2). RunID: dbf-8721. Started by maya.
router-ops: Applying initial shadow rule (no weight):
```
routerctl shadow add auth-service green
```
sam: Heads-up — session cookie name changed in v2.4.1. We'll set a cookie-version header to preserve old sessions for 30m: `session_v=old` vs `session_v=new`. Posting exact router rule next.
router-ops: Cookie stick rule ready:
```
route add-cookie-rule auth-service cookie:session_v allow=old->stick
```
deploy-bot: canary healthcheck OK. latency p50/p95: 22ms/85ms. no 5xx seen.
maya: Starting weight shift in ~5m. Plan to move 5% then pause checks before continuing. If anything trips, fallback to blue with the rollback command listed.
router-ops: Kicking first weight:```routerctl set-weight auth-service green=5 blue=95```
deploy-bot: traffic-update: green=5% applied.
sam: Noticing p95 jump to ~160ms in eu-west at 5%. Looks like cache cold on green instances. @andre can you check redis miss rate?
andre: Checking metrics — redis miss rate +12% on green. Likely cold post-upgrade. I'll kick a warm job to populate keys.
maya: Pause progression. Hold at 5% while cache warms. Requirement to resume: miss rate <5% and p95 <120ms. @sre-oncall stand by.
router-ops: Holding weights. Quick fallback command if needed:```routerctl set-weight auth-service green=0 blue=100```
deploy-bot: background-warm-job started (wc-993).
andre: Warm job done; redis miss rate back to baseline. p95 down to ~90ms.
maya: Resume — move to ~20% now.
router-ops: Applying:```routerctl set-weight auth-service green=20 blue=80```
deploy-bot: traffic-update: green=20%
sam: Note on sticky sessions: some older clients still send legacy cookie. Will set short Max-Age pin on blue so they finish on blue: `Set-Cookie: session_v=old; Max-Age=1800`.
router-ops: Header rewrite pushed for pinning.
deploy-bot: traffic-update: green=50%
andre: Metrics look stable, errors flat. Go ahead.
maya: Final ramp from 50->100 in 3m unless regressions. Rollback trigger: p95 > +30% or errors >0.5%. Everyone ready?
sam: Ready, monitoring client-side metrics and cookie behavior.
deploy-bot: traffic-update: green=100% — shift complete. RunID: dbf-8721 finished.
sre-oncall: Seeing OAuth 5xx spike at 00:48 UTC: 0.9% sustained for 3m. p95 creeping +45%. This crosses the rollback threshold.
maya: Initiating rollback plan now. Rolling traffic back to blue immediately.
router-ops: Executing rollback:
```
routerctl set-weight auth-service green=0 blue=100 --reason 'oauth 5xx spike'
```
deploy-bot: rollback-start auth-service v2.4.1 -> blue. RunID rbk-551. Initiated by maya.
sam: Pinning sessions to blue and reverting the cookie rewrite so legacy clients stay on blue.
andre: Root cause looks like a token refresh change in v2.4.1 that retries poorly with the oauth provider, causing 502 loops. Will revert config and prepare v2.4.2 hotfix. Also will add cache-warm hooks to the deploy pipeline.
deploy-bot: rollback-complete: traffic back to blue=100%. healthcheck: blue p95 70ms, oauth errors back to 0.05%.
maya: Nice work. Holding blue as stable. Action items: 1) sam — revert oauth provider change in v2.4.2, 2) andre — add cache warm hooks in deploys, 3) router-ops — add golden cookie-pin templates to infra. We'll schedule morning patch deploy in the next change window. :calendar:
router-ops: Will post ops release note and add cookie templates to infra repo now.
maya: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
